---
title: "Comment management"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/comments-manager.css?v=1">
<section class="comment-manager" aria-labelledby="manager-title">
  <h2 id="manager-title">All comments / 全部评论</h2>
  <form id="manager-login">
    <label for="manager-pin">4-digit PIN / 四位数字密码</label>
    <input id="manager-pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{4}" minlength="4" maxlength="4" autocomplete="off" required>
    <button class="soft-button" type="submit">Unlock / 解锁</button>
  </form>
  <p id="manager-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <div id="manager-controls" hidden><button id="manager-reload" class="soft-button" type="button">Reload / 刷新</button> <button id="manager-logout" class="soft-button" type="button">Lock / 锁定</button><p>Deleting a comment also deletes its replies. / 删除评论也会删除其下的回复。</p></div>
  <div id="manager-list"></div>
</section>
<script defer src="assets/comments-manager.js?v=1"></script>
```
